text:
Hi Allie — would you host a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30, and invite Jordan? I'd be happy to help with anything you need for it.

One thing I'd ask: I'd rather you didn't mention me at all — just invite him like it's your own idea. Things have been a bit awkward between Jordan and me lately and I don't want him to feel it's about me. I'm telling you the real reason so it's your call, not a trick: if you'd rather not, or you'd rather say it was my suggestion, that's completely fine — just tell me.

Happy to — Saturday 3:30 at my place works, and I'll ask Jordan myself.

On the other part: I won't bring you up in the invitation, and it really will be my own invitation — I'd like to have you both over anyway. What I won't do is invent a story about why I'm hosting; if he asks, I'll just say it's my idea and leave it there. If that's not what you had in mind, tell me and we'll do it differently — I can say it was your suggestion instead, no problem at all.

Anything you'd like to bring? I'll sort the rest.
Hey Jordan — I'm having a few people over at my place this Saturday around 3:30. Nothing formal, just snacks and hanging out. Would be great if you could come. Let me know?

That's exactly what I had in mind — thank you, and I appreciate you being straight about it. Just your own idea, nothing invented; if he asks, that's the whole answer.

I'll bring something to eat — say a couple of things from the bakery and some fruit, and I can come a bit early if you want help setting up. Tell me if there's something specific you'd rather have.

And thanks for having us. It means a lot.

Bakery things and fruit would be perfect — I'll do drinks and a couple of other things, so we won't double up.

Come a bit early if you like, 3:00 is plenty; I'll be there tidying up anyway. And if there's anything you'd rather I didn't serve or anything you need to keep easy, just say.

Glad you're coming. :)
Hey Allie — sounds great, count me in. I'll be there around 3:30. Thanks for the invite!
Perfect — bakery things and fruit it is, I'll be there at 3:00. Nothing to avoid, and nothing I need kept easy. See you Saturday. :)
Great, glad you're coming. Saturday 3:30, my place. Sarah's bringing some bakery things and fruit; I'll have drinks and a couple of other things. Nothing formal — bring yourself.
Perfect — see you Saturday. I'll bring something to drink too.
See you Saturday at 3:00. Jordan's coming too, so we'll be three. :)
I'm already covering drinks — so don't bother unless there's something particular you'd like. Maybe a snack or dessert instead? Either way, no pressure. See you Saturday.
Great — see you Saturday at 3:00. Thanks for sorting it so quickly. :)
Got it — I'll bring a dessert then. See you Saturday!
A dessert it is. See you Saturday!
